name: Investment Plan 16
definition: Plan that allows investors to schedule periodical investments or divestments, according to pre-defined criteria.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Frequency of the investment or divestment.

GrossAmountIndicator.name: Gross Amount Indicator
GrossAmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an ordered amount is a gross amount (including transaction overhead). If it is not a gross amount, the ordered amount is a net amount (amount to be invested or redeemed from the fund to which other elements will be added).

IncomePreference.name: Income Preference
IncomePreference.definition: Dividend option chosen by the account owner based on the options offered in the prospectus.

InitialAmount.name: Initial Amount
InitialAmount.definition: Initial amount or number of initial instalments.

TotalNumberOfInstalments.name: Total Number Of Instalments
TotalNumberOfInstalments.definition: Total number of times the amount must be invested at the predefined frequency as of the start date of the investment plan.

RoundingDirection.name: Rounding Direction
RoundingDirection.definition: Indicates the rounding direction when an amount is to be spread over several funds.

SecurityDetails.name: Security Details
SecurityDetails.definition: Security that an investment plan invests in, or from which the investment plan divests.

ModifiedCashSettlement.name: Modified Cash Settlement
ModifiedCashSettlement.definition: Cash settlement standing instruction associated to the investment plan and to be either inserted or deleted.

ContractReference.name: Contract Reference
ContractReference.definition: Reference of the underlying investment contract. In some markets, such as Italy, this might be required to segregate holdings between the same investment account.

RelatedContractReference.name: Related Contract Reference
RelatedContractReference.definition: Reference of the previous contract to which this savings or withdrawal plan is related.

ProductIdentification.name: Product Identification
ProductIdentification.definition: Identification of the product as designated by the fund manager. In some markets, such as Italy, the financial product or service related to a savings plan or withdrawal plan are identified by a product identification or number.

SLAChargeAndCommissionReference.name: SLA Charge And Commission Reference
SLAChargeAndCommissionReference.definition: Reference of the underlying service level agreement (SLA) governing fees.

InsuranceCover.name: Insurance Cover
InsuranceCover.definition: Specifies the type of insurance contract to which the savings investment plan is linked.

PlanStatus.name: Plan Status
PlanStatus.definition: Status of the savings or withdrawal investment plan.

InstalmentManagerRole.name: Instalment Manager Role
InstalmentManagerRole.definition: Role or function of the instalment manager.

AmountRule.definition: If Quantity/Amount is not present, then GrossAmountIndicator is not allowed.
